title: Profile-image operations time out
prompt: Starting at 11:27 UTC, profile image uploads and downloads time out, while profile text updates continue to work. Find the originating fault and explain the complete failure path.

evidence.content: Trace profile/upload total 10.0 s: profile validation 12 ms -> media-service PutObject 9.98 s ERROR deadline exceeded. Text-only profile traces complete in 44 ms.

evidence.summary: Media cannot resolve the object-store hostname
evidence.content: media-service: lookup objects.internal on 10.70.0.53:53: i/o timeout; PutObject aborted after resolver attempts exhausted.

evidence.summary: Media pods received a new resolver address
evidence.content: Deployment diff changed media-service dnsConfig.nameservers from 10.70.0.10 to 10.70.0.53. No other service selected this pod-template overlay.

evidence.summary: Configured resolver address has no responding endpoint
evidence.content: Synthetic UDP probes to 10.70.0.53:53 show 100% timeout. The active cluster resolver at 10.70.0.10 answers the same names in under 3 ms.

evidence.summary: Object storage remains healthy for other clients
evidence.content: Object-store availability is 100%; p95 is 26 ms. Backup and document-service clients successfully resolve and access objects.internal.
media-service CPU 18%, memory 33%, zero restarts, but outbound DNS timeout count rises from 0 to 1,940/min.

evidence.summary: Profile database reports occasional lock waits
evidence.content: Three profile row lock waits reached 80 ms, below the 250 ms warning threshold; no transaction failed.
